# Open differences between tests/fixtures/*/expected*.json (written by hand
# before the rules existed) and the engine, waiting for review. The expected
# files are never edited to match the engine; TestExpectedFindings passes
# only while the engine's differences are exactly these lines, so a new
# difference, or one that disappears, fails it.
#
# A - expected file omission: the paths rely on documented defaults
#     (DESIGN.md 4.7) that the hand-written files did not list:
#     eks.irsa.audience (no eks.amazonaws.com/audience annotation),
#     eks.irsa.oidc-provider-audience (no OIDC provider in the input; added
#     with the token modelling of the review, C) and
#     eks.pod-identity.disableSessionTags.
# E - found after the review, outside A-D: scenario 6. analytics-admin has
#     AdministratorAccess, so it can rewrite its own policies
#     (iam:PutRolePolicy on itself): narrowing its decrypt grant alone no
#     longer breaks the path, and the min-cut cuts the decrypt edges of
#     both the role and "the role with any permission" (cost 2, a new
#     fingerprint). One key-policy change would cut both; edge costs do
#     not express a fix shared by several edges. Waiting for a decision.
